source: Explicit human steering 2026-10-21: speculative tests optimize user-level decode throughput, including multi-batch users; do not rank speculation by throughput including prefill or by maximum large-batch aggregate throughput.
main_non_speculative_objective_unchanged: Adapt all three latest-refactor models and optimize useful aggregate output throughput per all serving cards toward measured hardware/operator/system ceilings.
speculative_primary_objective: Maximize per-request useful decode tokens per second; sweep concurrency to report the user-speed frontier.
primary_metrics: per-request decode tok/s distribution at B2/4/8/16
per-request mean decode TPOT and its cross-request P50/P95
nonzero inter-commit stall P95 and maximum; disclose burst delivery

timing_contract.anchor: Both AR and speculation finish target prefill and emit the initial target token at t0. Count useful committed output after that token until each request's final useful output; include all draft/target verify/selection/commit/replay and unhidden communication occurring after t0.
timing_contract.denominator: Each request's own observed decode elapsed time. Never substitute aggregate/B for heterogeneous request timing.
timing_contract.output_count: Only newly committed target-authorized output; exclude rejected/replayed proposals, repeated prefixes, EOS and any post-EOS output. Count each position once.
timing_contract.delivery: Multiple tokens committed together share a delivery timestamp. Do not infer smooth latency from zeros inside a burst; record inter-commit stalls and per-request average TPOT.
auxiliary_only: prefill/TTFT separately, never used to reject decode benefit

numeric_contract: Complete greedy output IDs including EOS/repeats equal the frozen ordinary target reference, finite logits, CPU argmax, actual owner/device/stream, normal cleanup and terminal Slurm. Raw equality diagnostic only. Native BF16/FP32 preferred, F64 reference/control only.

matrix.verify_positions: K+1 for K proposals under the current-token-plus-draft contract; distinguish K7/W8, K8/W9, K15/W16, K16/W17 explicitly.
matrix.eligibility: Run only compatible trained checkpoint/native window. 15/16 proposals are extension experiments unless compatible trained weights and input contracts are verified. Changing a block_size field alone is not a validated 16-token drafter.
matrix.comparison: Same target/dependencies/precision/topology and prompts; resident weights, ordinary/spec/spec/ordinary ABBA with repeated configurations. Stage short frozen continuation and state-rollback checks before the full matrix. No speed adoption from failed complete IDs.
